req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject non-string titles with an HTTP 422 response. This behavior needs to be validated through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The tests ensure that the API correctly handles valid string inputs, rejects non-string inputs, and respects boundary conditions for string lengths.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_string_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid string title.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Valid Task Title", "description": "A valid description.", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Valid Task Title"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_non_string_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a non-string title (e.g., integer).
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title must be a string.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": 12345, "description": "A valid description.", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value is not a valid string" in response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"]

tests.name: test_create_task_with_boundary_string_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title at the maximum allowed length.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "A valid description.", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
